rulings.try_again_equals_common: ACCEPT — 'Reintentar' is the right label for a connection retry; identical copy to mobile.common.try_again and mobile.computers.retry is fine, keys stay distinct.
rulings.sign_in_title_two_sentences: ACCEPT — English source is two sentences and the note says 'Two short sentences'; the trailing 'keep it one sentence' is boilerplate width text. Mirrors the source.
